KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Answers a greeting with the same greeting (Hujambo? Hujambo!) instead of its reply.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child hears the greeting as a sound to echo, as with "Hello" in English; the question-and-answer pair has not been learnt.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Rafiki anakusalimu: "Hujambo?" Unajibu nini?" with "Hujambo" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Act it as a ball game: the greeting is thrown, the reply is caught; the two words are on two different cards.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Ukiulizwa "Hujambo?" unajibu "Sijambo," maana yake sina tatizo.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Greets an elder with a peer or Sheng greeting (Mambo! Sasa!) instead of Shikamoo.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: Mambo and Sasa are what the child hears most among children and on the street; he has not been taught that an elder is greeted differently.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Unamwona babu njiani. Unamsalimu vipi?" with "Mambo babu!" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Sort picture cards of people (babu, rafiki, mwalimu) into two piles: Shikamoo and Hujambo.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Mzee husalimiwa kwa heshima: Shikamoo babu!
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Gives the elder's reply to the child's greeting the wrong way round (the elder says Shikamoo, or the child says Marahaba).

example.question: Mtoto anamsalimu bibi: "Shikamoo bibi!" Bibi anajibu nini?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: Both words are heard together and the child does not yet know which belongs to the young person and which to the elder.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Mtoto anamsalimu bibi: "Shikamoo bibi!" Bibi anajibu nini?" with "Shikamoo" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Role-play with a hat for the elder: only the one with the hat may say Marahaba.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Mtoto anasema Shikamoo; mzee anajibu Marahaba.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses the greeting of another time of day.

example.question: Mnakutana na mwalimu mchana baada ya chakula. Unamsalimu vipi?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child learnt one greeting as a set phrase and uses it at every hour.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Mnakutana na mwalimu mchana baada ya chakula. Unamsalimu vipi?" with "Habari za asubuhi mwalimu!" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: A clock or sun chart: asubuhi, mchana, jioni, usiku; the child moves the arrow and says the greeting for that time.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Salamu hufuata wakati: Habari za mchana mwalimu!
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Uses a greeting when leaving, or a farewell when arriving.

example.question: Unaondoka shuleni jioni. Unamuaga mwalimu vipi?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: Greeting and farewell words are learnt on one chart and the child mixes the two columns.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Unaondoka shuleni jioni. Unamuaga mwalimu vipi?" with "Hujambo mwalimu!" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Act out a door: walk in and greet, walk out and say goodbye.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.feedback: Unapoondoka unaaga: Kwaheri mwalimu, tutaonana kesho!
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.error: Greets a group with the singular greeting (Hujambo?) or answers for a group with Sijambo.

example.question: Mwalimu anaingia darasani na kusema: "Hamjambo wanafunzi?" Darasa linajibu nini?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.cause: The child knows one pair only; the plural forms hamjambo/hatujambo follow the person marker (m-, tu-), which has not been noticed.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anaingia darasani na kusema: "Hamjambo wanafunzi?" Darasa linajibu nini?" with "Sijambo" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.help: Greet one child, then the whole row; show that the word changes with one or many.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T1_MAAMKUZI_NA_MAAGANO.MA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.error: Gives "kukaribisha" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Leo ni siku ya kwanza ya Neema shuleni. Mwalimu alimkaribisha darasani kwa tabasamu. Neema alipata rafiki mpya anayeitwa Amani." Neno "kukaribisha" lina maana gani?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.reveals: The question "Soma: "Leo ni siku ya kwanza ya Neema shuleni. Mwalimu alimkaribisha darasani kwa tabasamu. Neema alipata rafiki mpya anayeitwa Amani." Neno "kukaribisha" lina maana gani?" with "kukasirisha" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.feedback: Katika kifungu, "kukaribisha" ni kumpokea mtu kwa furaha.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Shule ni mahali pazuri pa kupata marafiki na kujifunza.

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Neema alipata rafiki." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Shule ni mahali pazuri pa kupata marafiki na kujifunza.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for, without looking at the picture.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha kengele ikilia na watoto wakitoka nje. Nini kitatokea?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha kengele ikilia na watoto wakitoka nje. Nini kitatokea?" with "Watalala darasani." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.help: Underline the clue words and point at the picture; the guess must fit them.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za picha na za kifungu: Wataenda kucheza wakati wa mapumziko.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kuwakaribisha wanafunzi wapya kwa upendo.

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Mwalimu alitabasamu." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kuwakaribisha wanafunzi wapya kwa upendo.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.

example.question: Rafiki mpya wa Neema anaitwa nani?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.reveals: The question "Rafiki mpya wa Neema anaitwa nani?" with "Rafiki yangu anaitwa Juma." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T1_KUSOMA_UFAHAMU_KUSOM.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Hands in the first draft with crossings and does not make a clean copy.

example.question: Ni hatua gani ya mwisho ya kuandika kifungu?

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: The child thinks writing ends when the words are down; the steps maandalizi, nakala ya kwanza, urekebishaji, nakala safi are new.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Ni hatua gani ya mwisho ya kuandika kifungu?" with "nakala ya kwanza" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Show the four steps as four boxes; the child ticks each one.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Baada ya kurekebisha, andika nakala safi.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Leaves out words or a whole line when copying.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: The child copies letter by letter and loses his place when looking back.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Nakili: "Shule yetu ni safi."" with "Shule ni safi." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Copy phrase by phrase, moving a finger along the line; read the copy back against the original.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Soma nakala yako na ulinganishe na ya asili.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Put a finger space after every word.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T1_HATI_NADHIFU.HATI_NADH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.error: The pronoun and the subject marker on the verb do not agree (Wao anacheza).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.cause: The child learns the pronoun as a word and the verb as a fixed form; he has not seen that the verb changes with the person.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.reveals: The question "Jaza: Nyinyi ___ (soma) vizuri." with "unasoma" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.help: Colour the pronoun and the verb's first syllable the same colour: yeye a-, wao wa-, mimi ni-, sisi tu-, wewe u-, nyinyi m-.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.feedback: Kitendo hufuata nafsi: Wao wanacheza; Yeye anacheza. (mnasoma)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.error: Uses the one-person pronoun for many people, or the reverse.

example.question: Mwalimu anaongea na darasa zima: "___ mnafanya kazi nzuri."

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.cause: The child has not linked the pronoun pair to one and many.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anaongea na darasa zima: "___ mnafanya kazi nzuri."" with "Wewe" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.help: Point at one child, then at a group, saying the right pronoun each time.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.feedback: Mtu mmoja ni yeye; watu wengi ni wao. (Nyinyi)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.error: Repeats the pronoun of the question in the answer (Wewe unaenda wapi? Wewe ninaenda sokoni.) instead of switching to mimi.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.cause: The child copies the words he heard; changing person between speakers is new.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.reveals: The question "Rafiki anakuuliza: "Wewe unaitwa nani?" Unajibu:" with "Wewe unaitwa Baraka." among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.help: Ask and answer in pairs with a pointing finger: wewe points out, mimi points to the chest.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.feedback: Ukiulizwa kwa "wewe", unajibu kwa "mimi". (Mimi ninaitwa Baraka.)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.error: Puts the pronoun after the verb instead of the object marker inside it (Mama alimpa mimi for Mama alinipa).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.cause: English says "gave me"; the child adds the separate word instead of -ni- inside the verb.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Nitampa wewe kalamu." among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.help: Show the verb with the object marker coloured: a-li-ni-pa; compare with the wrong form.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T1_MATUMIZI_YA_WEWE_NA_.N.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "mwezi". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /mw/, or do not separate it from /w/; the child puts in the home sound.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "mwezi". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "wezi" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Pushes a vowel into the cluster, so "mwalimu" is said "muwalimu".
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: In the child's first language, or in English loan habits, two consonants rarely sit together; he breaks them with a vowel.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Tamka neno "mwalimu". Ni lipi sahihi?" with "muwalimu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the cluster in one beat, then the word; clap once for the cluster syllable.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: "mwalimu" ina silabi mwa-li-mu; hakuna irabu ya ziada.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Drops part of the target sound, so "njia" becomes "jia".

example.question: Neno "njia" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The second part of the sound (the w or y glide, or the soft nasal) is quick and quiet; the child does not hear it and leaves it out.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "njia" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?" with "jia" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Stretch the syllable slowly (p-y-a), then say it fast; the child copies.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "njia". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Splits "mwalimu" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "mwalimu" lina silabi zipi?" with "m-w-a-l-i-m-u" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: mwa-li-mu.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /mw/, /nj/?" with "kalamu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T2_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "mwanafunzi" as "muwanafunzi".
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Neno "mwanafunzi" linasomwa vipi?" with "muwanafunzi" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Kila mtoto ana haki ya chakula."?
example.wrong_answer: Kila ... mtoto ... ana ... haki ... ya ... chakula.
example.correct_answer: Kila mtoto ana haki ya chakula.

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Kila mtoto ana haki ya chakula."?" with "Kila ... mtoto ... ana ... haki ... ya ... chakula." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 33 kwa dakika

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, una nguo safi?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, una nguo safi?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T2_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.error: Starts a sentence or a name with a small letter.

example.question: Andika kwa usahihi: mwalimu akinyi anafundisha darasa la pili.
example.wrong_answer: mwalimu akinyi anafundisha darasa la pili.
example.correct_answer: Mwalimu Akinyi anafundisha darasa la pili.

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.cause: The child copies words, not sentences; the rule that a sentence and a name begin with a capital is not yet used.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.reveals: The question "Andika kwa usahihi: mwalimu akinyi anafundisha darasa la pili." with "mwalimu akinyi anafundisha darasa la pili." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.help: Circle the first letter of each sentence and each name in a passage in red.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.feedback: Sentensi na jina la mtu au mahali huanza kwa herufi kubwa.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.error: Puts capital letters in the middle of words (JuMa, Kitabu KiKubwa).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.cause: Some capitals (K, M, S) are easier to form than the small letter, so the child uses them anywhere.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "JuMa ANakula" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.help: Sort letter cards: capital only at the start; the rest small.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.feedback: Herufi kubwa iko mwanzoni tu; nyingine ni ndogo.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.help: Put a finger space after every word.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T2_HATI_NADHIFU_HERUFI_.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.error: Makes the plural with the prefix of another noun class (kitabu -> watabu).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.cause: The child knows that wa- makes people plural and uses it for everything; the ngeli of the noun is not yet known.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "kitanda changu" ni?" with "watanda wetu" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.help: Sort noun cards into ngeli families (m-wa, ki-vi, li-ma, n-n) and say each plural aloud.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.feedback: Kila ngeli ina wingi wake: kitabu - vitabu, mtoto - watoto. (vitanda vyetu)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.error: Leaves the possessive singular with a plural noun (vitabu changu).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.cause: The child changes the noun and forgets the possessive.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "kiatu changu" ni?" with "viatu changu" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.help: Change one object to many in front of the child; both words change.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.feedback: Vitabu vyangu: vyote viwili hubadilika. (viatu vyetu)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.error: Shows the plural only with a number word and leaves the noun singular (kitabu mbili).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.cause: English and some first languages keep the noun and add a number; Kiswahili changes the noun and the number agrees.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "kikombe kimoja" ni?" with "kikombe viwili" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.help: Line up two books: the child says vitabu viwili; then three: vitabu vitatu.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.feedback: Nomino hubadilika pia: vitabu viwili. (vikombe viwili)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.error: Takes the plural form for the singular (miti for one tree, vitabu for one book).

example.question: Ni kifungu kipi kiko katika umoja?

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.cause: The child heard the plural more often (a tree is usually among trees) and learnt it as the name.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.reveals: The question "Ni kifungu kipi kiko katika umoja?" with "vyakula vyetu" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.help: Hold one object, then many; the child names each.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.feedback: Kimoja ni kitabu; vingi ni vitabu. (chakula changu)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.error: Uses the wrong noun-class form of the possessive (kitabu yangu for kitabu changu).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.cause: Town Kiswahili uses yangu, yako, yake for every noun; the child has not seen the ngeli agreement.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.reveals: The question "Jaza: chakula ___ (-angu)" with "yangu" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.help: Pair nouns and possessives by colour: kitabu changu, kiti chake, mtoto wangu.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.feedback: Kitabu changu; kiti chake: kimilikishi hufuata ngeli. (changu)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T2_UMOJA_NA_WINGI_WA_VI.U.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.error: Says samahani when someone else is hurt by accident, where pole (sympathy) is meant.

example.question: Rafiki ameanguka mwenyewe uwanjani. Unamwambia nini?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.cause: English "sorry" covers both apology and sympathy; Kiswahili separates them: samahani when I did wrong, pole when you suffer.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.reveals: The question "Rafiki ameanguka mwenyewe uwanjani. Unamwambia nini?" with "Samahani" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.help: Two pictures: I stepped on your foot (samahani); you fell by yourself (pole). The child names each.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.feedback: Pole ni ya kumhurumia aliyeumia; samahani ni ya kuomba msamaha ukikosea.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Ulimpa rafiki kalamu, akasema "Asante." Unajibu nini?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.cause: The child echoes the polite word he has just heard.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.reveals: The question "Ulimpa rafiki kalamu, akasema "Asante." Unajibu nini?" with "Asante" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.help: Practise the pair with two children: one gives, one thanks, the giver answers Karibu.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.error: Asks with a bare command (Nipe maji!) without tafadhali or naomba.

example.question: Unataka maji kutoka kwa mama. Unasemaje?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.cause: At home and in play the child hears short commands and copies them to adults.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.reveals: The question "Unataka maji kutoka kwa mama. Unasemaje?" with "Nipe maji!" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.help: Say both versions; the child says which one makes mama want to help.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.error: Calls an adult by the bare first name without a title (Mwalimu, Mama, Baba, Bi., Bw.).

example.question: Unamwita mwalimu wako, Bi. Akinyi. Unasemaje?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.cause: Children call each other by name and carry the habit to adults.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.reveals: The question "Unamwita mwalimu wako, Bi. Akinyi. Unasemaje?" with "Akinyi, njoo!" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.help: Make title cards (Mwalimu, Mama, Babu, Daktari); the child puts one before each name.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.feedback: Mtu mzima huitwa kwa heshima: Mwalimu, Mama, Babu.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.cause: The child echoes the word, as with greetings.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.reveals: The question "Rafiki anakuambia "Pole kwa kuumia." Unajibu?" with "Pole" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.help: Act it: one child is hurt, the other says pole, the hurt one says asante.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T3_MANENO_YA_HESHIMA_NA.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.error: Gives "afya" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Kila asubuhi, Baraka hula uji na ndizi. Mchana hula wali, maharagwe na mboga. Mama husema chakula bora hutupa nguvu na afya." Neno "afya" lina maana gani?
example.correct_answer: hali ya mwili kuwa mzima bila ugonjwa

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.reveals: The question "Soma: "Kila asubuhi, Baraka hula uji na ndizi. Mchana hula wali, maharagwe na mboga. Mama husema chakula bora hutupa nguvu na afya." Neno "afya" lina maana gani?" with "nyanya" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.feedback: Katika kifungu, "afya" ni hali ya mwili kuwa mzima bila ugonjwa.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tule chakula bora ili tuwe na nguvu na afya.

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Baraka hula uji asubuhi." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tule chakula bora ili tuwe na nguvu na afya.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for, without looking at the picture.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha Baraka akikataa mboga. Mama atafanya nini?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha Baraka akikataa mboga. Mama atafanya nini?" with "Atampa pipi." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.help: Underline the clue words and point at the picture; the guess must fit them.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za picha na za kifungu: Atamweleza umuhimu wa kula mboga.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kula vyakula vya aina mbalimbali.

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Baraka hula wali mchana." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kula vyakula vya aina mbalimbali.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.reveals: The question "Baraka hula nini asubuhi?" with "Mimi hunywa chai." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.feedback: Jibu liko kwenye kifungu: uji na ndizi
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T3_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.error: Writes the tall small letters (b, d, h, k, l) short, so h looks like n.

example.question: Andika neno "habari". Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.cause: The child does not use the lines of the book: tall letters must reach the top line.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.reveals: The question "Andika neno "habari". Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "nabari" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.help: Write on three-line paper; the child colours the part of h that goes up.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.feedback: Herufi h, k, l, b, d hupanda juu ya mstari wa kati.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.error: Writes some small letters as big as capitals (kiti written kiTi or KITI).

example.question: Ni neno lipi limeandikwa kwa herufi ndogo vizuri?

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.cause: Capitals were learnt first in pre-primary and feel safer to write.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi limeandikwa kwa herufi ndogo vizuri?" with "KITI" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.help: Compare k/K, s/S, t/T on cards; the child picks the small one for the middle of a word.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.feedback: Ndani ya neno tumia herufi ndogo.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.help: Put a finger space after every word.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T3_MPANGILIO_WA_HERUFI_.H.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.error: Uses the people word (huyu, yule) for a thing (kiti huyu).

example.question: Jaza: Kikombe ___ (kilicho karibu nawe) ni chako.

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.cause: Huyu was the first pointing word learnt; the child uses it for anything.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kikombe ___ (kilicho karibu nawe) ni chako." with "huyo" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.help: Point at a child (huyu) and at a chair (hiki); then sort pictures by the pointing word they take.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.feedback: Kitu cha ngeli ya ki-vi huonyeshwa kwa hiki; mtu huonyeshwa kwa huyu. (hicho)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.error: Uses the one-thing pointing word with a plural noun (watoto huyu).

example.question: Jaza: Wapishi ___ (walio karibu nawe) ni hodari.

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.cause: The child changes the noun but not the pointing word.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Wapishi ___ (walio karibu nawe) ni hodari." with "huyo" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.help: Pair the forms on cards: huyu-hawa, yule-wale, hiki-hivi, hili-haya.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.error: Mixes near and far pointing words (huyu for someone far away; yule for someone close).

example.question: Mtoto amesimama karibu nami. Ninasema: Mtoto ___ ni dada yangu.

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.cause: The child has not linked the forms to distance from the speaker.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.reveals: The question "Mtoto amesimama karibu nami. Ninasema: Mtoto ___ ni dada yangu." with "huyo" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.help: Stand near one child and far from another; point and say huyu and yule; then swap places.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.feedback: Huyu ni karibu nami; yule ni mbali. (huyu)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.error: Uses hii for every noun (kitabu hii, mtoto hii), as in town Kiswahili.

example.question: Jaza: Mama ___ (aliye karibu nawe) anauza matunda.

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.cause: Hii is the pointing word heard most in town speech, where the noun class is dropped.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Mama ___ (aliye karibu nawe) anauza matunda." with "hii" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.help: Read pairs aloud: kitabu hiki, mtoto huyu, nyumba hii; the child hears the match.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.feedback: Kitabu hiki; mtoto huyu; nyumba hii. (huyo)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T3_MATUMIZI_YA_HUYO_NA_.V.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "dhoruba". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /dh/, or do not separate it from /z/; the child puts in the home sound.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "dhoruba". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "zoruba" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.cause: /ch/ and /sh/ are close; a first language with only one of them puts that one in both places.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.reveals: The question "Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "shombo" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.help: Contrast the two with a mirror and a hand before the mouth; the child says which he hears.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.error: Drops part of the target sound, so "dhahabu" becomes "dahabu".

example.question: Neno "dhahabu" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.cause: The second part of the sound (the w or y glide, or the soft nasal) is quick and quiet; the child does not hear it and leaves it out.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.reveals: The question "Neno "dhahabu" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?" with "dahabu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.help: Stretch the syllable slowly (p-y-a), then say it fast; the child copies.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "dhahabu". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.error: Splits "chombo" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.reveals: The question "Neno "chombo" lina silabi zipi?" with "c-h-o-m-b-o" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: cho-mbo.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /ch/, /dh/?" with "basi" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T4_MATAMSHI_BORA_SAUTI_.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "dhahabu" as "zahabu".
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.reveals: The question "Neno "dhahabu" linasomwa vipi?" with "zahabu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Basi linabeba abiria wengi."?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Basi linabeba abiria wengi."?" with "Basi ... linabeba ... abiria ... wengi." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 36 kwa dakika

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, dereva amefunga mkanda?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, dereva amefunga mkanda?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T4_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA_S.K.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.cause: Speech runs words together and the child writes the stream as he hears it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Basilimefikamapema." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.help: Put a finger space after each word; count the words aloud first.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.error: Splits the verb into its parts (ni na kwenda, a li fika).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.cause: The child hears the parts of the verb as separate sounds and writes a space after each.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Mimi ni na kwenda sokoni." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.help: Underline the whole verb in one line; it is one word however long.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.error: Puts a space inside a word at a syllable (ba si, ga ri).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.cause: The child has learnt to write syllable by syllable and leaves a gap after each.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Ga ri ni jekundu." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.help: Write the syllables close together and read the word aloud; then the gap goes after the word.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.feedback: Silabi za neno moja hukaa pamoja: gari.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.error: Leaves very large gaps between some words and none between others.

example.question: Nafasi kati ya maneno inafaa kuwa vipi?

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.cause: The child does not measure; he writes as space allows on the line.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.reveals: The question "Nafasi kati ya maneno inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "yoyote, kubwa au ndogo" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.help: Use a finger or a lolly stick as the measure for each gap.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.feedback: Kila nafasi iwe sawa na kidole kimoja.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T4_NAFASI_KATIKA_MAANDI.N.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.error: Makes the plural with the prefix of another noun class (kitabu -> watabu).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.cause: The child knows that wa- makes people plural and uses it for everything; the ngeli of the noun is not yet known.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "mwendeshaji" ni?" with "miendeshaji" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.help: Sort noun cards into ngeli families (m-wa, ki-vi, li-ma, n-n) and say each plural aloud.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.feedback: Kila ngeli ina wingi wake: kitabu - vitabu, mtoto - watoto. (waendeshaji)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.error: Gives a noun of the n-n class a plural prefix (nyumba -> manyumba), or changes an irregular noun wrongly (jicho -> majicho).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.cause: The child expects every plural to look different; n-n nouns stay the same and some li-ma nouns change their stem.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "ndege moja" ni?" with "mandege mawili" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.help: Keep a short list of the same-in-both nouns (nyumba, ndizi, kalamu) and the irregular ones (jicho - macho, jino - meno).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.feedback: Baadhi ya nomino hazibadiliki, na baadhi hubadilika kwa njia yake. (ndege mbili)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.error: Shows the plural only with a number word and leaves the noun singular (kitabu mbili).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.cause: English and some first languages keep the noun and add a number; Kiswahili changes the noun and the number agrees.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "gari moja" ni?" with "gari mbili" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.help: Line up two books: the child says vitabu viwili; then three: vitabu vitatu.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.feedback: Nomino hubadilika pia: vitabu viwili. (magari mawili)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.error: Takes the plural form for the singular (miti for one tree, vitabu for one book).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.cause: The child heard the plural more often (a tree is usually among trees) and learnt it as the name.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.reveals: The question "Ni lipi liko katika umoja?" with "magari" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.help: Hold one object, then many; the child names each.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.feedback: Kimoja ni kitabu; vingi ni vitabu. (gari)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.error: Leaves the adjective singular with a plural noun (watoto mzuri).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.cause: The child changes the noun only.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "basi kubwa" ni?" with "mabasi kubwa" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.help: Change the noun to many and ask the child to change every word that goes with it.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T4_UMOJA_NA_WINGI.UMOJA_W.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.error: Gives a detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ulichosikiliza ni upi?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.cause: The detail is the clearest thing the child remembers; he has not been asked what the passage teaches.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ulichosikiliza ni upi?" with "Sungura alikuwa na chakula." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.help: After listening, ask "Kifungu kinatufundisha nini?" and compare it with "Nini kilitokea?".
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Akili hutusaidia kujiokoa tukiwa hatarini.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.error: Gives "mjanja" the meaning of a word that sounds like it.

example.question: Neno "mjanja" katika kifungu lina maana gani?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.cause: The child matches the sound of the word to one he knows instead of listening to the sentence around it.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.reveals: The question "Neno "mjanja" katika kifungu lina maana gani?" with "mjinga" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.help: Replay the sentence; the child tries each meaning in it and keeps the one that makes sense.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.feedback: Katika kifungu, "mjanja" ni mwenye akili ya kutafuta njia.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.error: Makes a "sentence" that only repeats the word and shows no meaning (mjanja ni mjanja).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi inaonyesha maana ya "mjanja"?
example.correct_answer: Sungura mjanja alitafuta njia ya kumtoroka fisi.

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.cause: The child thinks any sentence with the word in it is enough.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi inaonyesha maana ya "mjanja"?" with "Mjanja ni mjanja." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.help: Ask: if your friend did not know the word, would your sentence tell him what it means?
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.feedback: Sentensi nzuri inaonyesha maana ya neno.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.error: Retells the events out of order.

example.question: Panga matukio ya kifungu kama yalivyotokea.
example.wrong_answer: Sungura alitoroka, fisi alimkuta sungura, sungura alimdanganya fisi
example.correct_answer: Fisi alimkuta sungura, sungura alimdanganya fisi, sungura akatoroka

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.cause: The child remembers the most exciting event and tells it first.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.reveals: The question "Panga matukio ya kifungu kama yalivyotokea." with "Sungura alitoroka, fisi alimkuta sungura, sungura alimdanganya fisi" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.help: Three picture cards of the events; the child lays them left to right and retells with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.feedback: Matukio yalifuatana hivi: Fisi alimkuta sungura, sungura alimdanganya fisi, sungura akatoroka.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.error: Adds events that were not in the passage when retelling.

example.question: Unaposimulia upya, unaongeza mambo ambayo hayakuwa kwenye kifungu?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.cause: Retelling is taken as storytelling: the child invents to make it longer.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.reveals: The question "Unaposimulia upya, unaongeza mambo ambayo hayakuwa kwenye kifungu?" with "ndiyo, ili hadithi iwe tamu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.help: After the retelling, the class checks each event: was it in the passage? Thumbs up or down.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.feedback: Kusimulia upya ni kusema yaliyokuwa kwenye kifungu tu.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T5_UFAHAMU_WA_KUSIKILIZ.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives "hulinda" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Kiprono ana mbwa anayeitwa Simba. Kila siku humpa chakula na maji. Usiku, Simba hulinda nyumba dhidi ya wezi." Neno "hulinda" lina maana gani?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Soma: "Kiprono ana mbwa anayeitwa Simba. Kila siku humpa chakula na maji. Usiku, Simba hulinda nyumba dhidi ya wezi." Neno "hulinda" lina maana gani?" with "hulima" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Katika kifungu, "hulinda" ni huangalia ili pasiwe na hatari.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Mbwa anaitwa Simba." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tukiwatunza wanyama wetu, nao hutusaidia.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for, without looking at the picture.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha mtu asiyejulikana langoni usiku. Simba atafanya nini?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha mtu asiyejulikana langoni usiku. Simba atafanya nini?" with "Atalala." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Underline the clue words and point at the picture; the guess must fit them.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za picha na za kifungu: Atabweka ili kuwaamsha watu.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Kiprono humpa mbwa maji." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kuwatunza wanyama wetu.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Mbwa wa Kiprono anaitwa nani?" with "Mbwa wetu anaitwa Bobi." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T5_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.error: Ends a question with a kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.cause: The child ends every sentence the same way.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.reveals: The question "Weka alama sahihi: Unaenda wapi" with "Unaenda wapi." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.help: Read the sentence aloud: if the voice rises and asks, it takes a kiulizi.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.error: Puts a kiulizi after a statement.

example.question: Weka alama sahihi: Mimi ninaenda sokoni

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.cause: The child uses ? as a decoration or thinks any sentence about himself is a question.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.reveals: The question "Weka alama sahihi: Mimi ninaenda sokoni" with "Mimi ninaenda sokoni?" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.help: Ask: does the sentence want an answer? If not, kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.feedback: Sentensi ya kueleza huishia kwa kikomo (.).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.error: Puts a kiulizi after a reported question (Mama aliniuliza ninaenda wapi?).

example.question: Weka alama sahihi: Mama aliniuliza ninaenda wapi

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.cause: The question word wapi makes the child think the sentence is a question; it only tells that one was asked.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.reveals: The question "Weka alama sahihi: Mama aliniuliza ninaenda wapi" with "Mama aliniuliza ninaenda wapi?" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.help: Compare "Unaenda wapi?" (asked now) with "Aliniuliza ninaenda wapi." (told).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.feedback: Sentensi hii inaeleza kwamba swali liliulizwa; huishia kwa kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.error: Puts several kiulizi (???) for a strong question.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.cause: Text messages and cartoons use many marks; the child copies them.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Je, sungura anakula nini???" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.help: One question, one kiulizi; show a page from the class reader.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.error: Writes a small letter after a kikomo or kiulizi.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.cause: The child does not link the mark to the capital that follows it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Sungura anakula majani. mama alifurahi." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.help: Every kikomo is a gate: the next word starts big.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T5_UAKIFISHI.ALAMA.M2_ALA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.error: Uses the wrong noun-class form of the possessive (kitabu yangu for kitabu changu).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.cause: Town Kiswahili uses yangu, yako, yake for every noun; the child has not seen the ngeli agreement.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Mbwa ___ (-ako) ni mkubwa." with "yako" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.help: Pair nouns and possessives by colour: kitabu changu, kiti chake, mtoto wangu.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.feedback: Kitabu changu; kiti chake: kimilikishi hufuata ngeli. (wako)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.error: Leaves the possessive singular with a plural noun (vitabu changu).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.cause: The child changes the noun and forgets the possessive.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Vikombe ___ (-ako) ni safi." with "chako" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.help: Change one object to many in front of the child; both words change.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.error: Uses the possessive of the wrong owner (-ake for something that is his own, -ake for many owners).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.cause: The child has not linked -angu, -ako, -ake, -etu, -enu, -ao to who owns the thing.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anawaambia wanafunzi wote: "Leteni madaftari ___."" with "yako" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.help: Hold up an object: Ni cha nani? Answer with the owner first, then the possessive.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.feedback: Mwenye kitu ni nani? Mimi: changu; yeye: chake; wao: chao. (yenu)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.error: Puts the possessive before the noun (yangu kalamu), in English word order.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.cause: English puts "my" before the noun; Kiswahili puts it after.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "wako paka" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.help: Build the phrase with cards: the noun first, then the possessive.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.feedback: Nomino kwanza, kimilikishi baadaye: kalamu yangu. (paka wako)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T5_MATUMIZI_YA_AKO_NA_E.V.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "nyanya". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /ny/, or do not separate it from /n/; the child puts in the home sound.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "nyanya". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "nanya" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Pushes a vowel into the cluster, so "nyota" is said "niyota".
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: In the child's first language, or in English loan habits, two consonants rarely sit together; he breaks them with a vowel.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Tamka neno "nyota". Ni lipi sahihi?" with "niyota" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the cluster in one beat, then the word; clap once for the cluster syllable.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: "nyota" ina silabi nyo-ta; hakuna irabu ya ziada.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Drops part of the target sound, so "ngoma" becomes "goma".

example.question: Neno "ngoma" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The second part of the sound (the w or y glide, or the soft nasal) is quick and quiet; the child does not hear it and leaves it out.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "ngoma" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?" with "goma" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Stretch the syllable slowly (p-y-a), then say it fast; the child copies.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "ngoma". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Splits "nyanya" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "nyanya" lina silabi zipi?" with "n-y-a-n-y-a" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: nya-nya.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /ny/, /ng/?" with "baba" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T6_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "nyumba" as "numba".
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Neno "nyumba" linasomwa vipi?" with "numba" among the options.
