KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Babu na bibi wanaishi kijijini."?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Babu na bibi wanaishi kijijini."?" with "Babu ... na ... bibi ... wanaishi ... kijijini." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 39 kwa dakika

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umemtembelea nyanya?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umemtembelea nyanya?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T6_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.error: Spells the word with the sound of his first language: "shangazi" written "sangazi".
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.cause: The child writes as he says the word; if his first language merges the two sounds, the letter is a guess.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "sangazi" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.help: Keep a list of the class's hard pairs (l/r, s/sh, z/dh, s/th); say each word slowly before writing.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.feedback: Andika "shangazi" kama linavyotamkwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.cause: The n or m before a consonant is soft and quick; the child does not hear it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "dugu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.help: Hum the nasal before the word (mmm-bwa, nnn-dege).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.error: Writes a long vowel short, so the word changes: "kaa" written "ka".

example.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "kuketi au kuishi mahali".

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.cause: The child hears the length but does not know it is shown by two letters.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.reveals: The question "Andika neno lenye maana ya "kuketi au kuishi mahali"." with "ka" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.help: Clap the two vowels as two beats; compare a word with one and two vowels.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.error: Writes ng' without the apostrophe (ngombe for ng'ombe), or puts it where it does not belong (ng'oma for ngoma).

example.question: Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.cause: Ng' and ng are two sounds; the apostrophe looks like dirt on the page to the child.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?" with "ngombe" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.help: Say ng'ombe and ngoma: the first has no g sound; mark it with the apostrophe.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.error: Joins two words into one, or splits one word into two (kwasababu; mwana funzi).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.cause: In speech the words run together; the child has not seen each written apart.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Nilichelewa kwasababu ya mvua." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.help: Count the words aloud with a finger for each before writing.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T6_TAHAJIA_IMLA.IMLA.M2_T.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.error: Gives the adjective the people prefix whatever the noun (kiti mzuri).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.cause: Mzuri is the form the child hears most (mtoto mzuri) and is used everywhere.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kiti ___ (-kubwa)." with "mkubwa" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.help: Match noun and adjective by colour: kiti kizuri, mtoto mzuri, vitu vizuri.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.error: Gives an n-n noun the m- form of the adjective (nyumba mzuri for nyumba nzuri).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.cause: The n- prefix and its sound changes (nzuri, ndefu, nyeupe) are new to the child.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Nyumba ___ (-refu)." with "mrefu" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.help: Read pairs aloud: nyumba nzuri, kalamu ndefu, nguo nyeupe.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.error: Puts the adjective before the noun (mzuri mtoto), in English word order.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.cause: English puts the describing word first.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "mrefu babu" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.help: Build with cards: noun first, then the adjective.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.error: Leaves the adjective singular with a plural noun (watoto mzuri).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.cause: The child changes the noun only.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Wajomba ___ (-refu)." with "mrefu" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.help: Change the noun to many and ask the child to change every word that goes with it.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.error: Picks the opposite member of the pair (mrefu for a short person).

example.question: Picha inaonyesha mti mfupi. Mti ni ___.

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.cause: The pair is learnt together and the two words are swapped.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha mti mfupi. Mti ni ___." with "mrefu" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.help: Act the pairs with the body: stretch for refu, crouch for fupi.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.feedback: Angalia picha tena na uchague neno linalofaa. (mfupi)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T6_MATUMIZI_YA_REFU_KUB.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.error: Carries out only the first part of a two-step instruction.

example.question: Agizo: "Panga viti, kisha ufagie sebule." Umefanya nini?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.cause: The child starts acting as soon as he hears the first verb and stops listening.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.reveals: The question "Agizo: "Panga viti, kisha ufagie sebule." Umefanya nini?" with "anapanga viti tu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.help: Hold up one finger for each step while giving the instruction; the child repeats the steps before moving.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.feedback: Sikiliza agizo lote kwanza, kisha fanya hatua zote.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.error: Does the steps in the wrong order.

example.question: Agizo: "Osha mikono, kisha ule chakula." Ni nini kinatangulia?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.cause: The child does the step he wants most first; the order words kwanza and kisha are not yet noticed.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.reveals: The question "Agizo: "Osha mikono, kisha ule chakula." Ni nini kinatangulia?" with "kula chakula" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.help: Number the steps on the board with kwanza, kisha, mwishowe.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.error: Mixes a direction or action word.

example.question: Agizo: "Weka kikombe juu ya meza." Ni kitendo kipi sahihi?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.cause: Pairs such as kulia/kushoto and juu/chini are learnt together and swapped.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.reveals: The question "Agizo: "Weka kikombe juu ya meza." Ni kitendo kipi sahihi?" with "anakiweka chini ya meza" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.help: Play "Mwalimu anasema": the teacher calls the word, the child acts it; mark the right hand with a band.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.feedback: Weka kikombe juu ya meza. maana yake ni anakiweka juu ya meza.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.error: Gives an instruction that leaves out what to act on, or with no polite word (Lete!).

example.question: Ni agizo lipi liko wazi na lina adabu?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.cause: The child knows what he means and does not see that the listener cannot.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.reveals: The question "Ni agizo lipi liko wazi na lina adabu?" with "Lete!" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.help: The child gives the instruction to a partner, who does exactly what was said and no more.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.feedback: Agizo zuri linasema nini kifanyike, kwa kitu gani, na kwa adabu.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T7_MAAGIZO.MAAGIZO.M2_MAG.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.error: Gives "sakafu" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Sebuleni kwetu kuna viti vinne, meza na runinga. Kila Jumamosi, mimi na dada yangu hupangusa vumbi na kufagia sakafu. Sebule huwa safi na nadhifu." Neno "sakafu" lina maana gani?
example.correct_answer: sehemu ya chini ya chumba tunayoikanyaga

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.reveals: The question "Soma: "Sebuleni kwetu kuna viti vinne, meza na runinga. Kila Jumamosi, mimi na dada yangu hupangusa vumbi na kufagia sakafu. Sebule huwa safi na nadhifu." Neno "sakafu" lina maana gani?" with "safari" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.feedback: Katika kifungu, "sakafu" ni sehemu ya chini ya chumba tunayoikanyaga.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Kuna viti vinne." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tushirikiane kuweka nyumba yetu safi.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for, without looking at the picture.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha wageni wakibisha mlango. Watoto watafanya nini?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha wageni wakibisha mlango. Watoto watafanya nini?" with "Watajificha." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.help: Underline the clue words and point at the picture; the guess must fit them.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za picha na za kifungu: Watawakaribisha wageni sebuleni.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Kuna runinga sebuleni." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kusaidia kazi za nyumbani.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.reveals: The question "Watoto husafisha sebule siku gani?" with "Sisi husafisha Jumapili." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T7_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU_K.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.error: Thinks editing means copying the same writing more neatly, mistakes and all.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.cause: The child has seen clean copies praised and thinks neatness is the whole job.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.reveals: The question "Kuhariri ni nini?" with "kuandika upya kwa mwandiko mzuri" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.help: Give a short passage with three planted mistakes; the child finds them before copying.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.feedback: Kuhariri ni kutafuta na kusahihisha makosa.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.error: Does not read his writing back, so a missing word stays missing.

example.question: Sahihisha: Mama alipika chakula kitamu sana sana.
example.wrong_answer: Mama alipika chakula kitamu sana sana.

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.cause: The child knows what he meant and his eye fills the gap or skips the repeat.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.reveals: The question "Sahihisha: Mama alipika chakula kitamu sana sana." with "Mama alipika chakula kitamu sana sana." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.help: Read it aloud with a finger under each word.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.feedback: Soma kwa sauti, neno kwa neno.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.error: Checks spelling only and leaves out the capital and the kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.cause: Spelling is what the teacher marks most, so it is all the child looks for.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.reveals: The question "Hariri: tuliketi sebuleni" with "tuliketi sebuleni" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.help: An editing card: Herufi kubwa? Kikomo? Neno limekosekana? Tahajia?
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.feedback: Angalia herufi kubwa mwanzoni na kikomo mwishoni.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.error: Rubs out so hard the page tears, or scribbles over the error so it cannot be read.

example.question: Ukipata kosa, unafanya nini?
example.wrong_answer: ninalifuta kwa nguvu au kulichora juu
example.correct_answer: ninapiga mstari mmoja juu yake na kuandika sahihi

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.cause: The child fears a mistake showing.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.reveals: The question "Ukipata kosa, unafanya nini?" with "ninalifuta kwa nguvu au kulichora juu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.help: Show one neat line through the error and the right word above it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.feedback: Piga mstari mmoja juu ya kosa, andika sahihi.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T7_UHARIRI.UHARIRI.M2_HAR.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.error: Keeps the final -a in the negative present (hasoma for hasomi).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.cause: The child adds the negative prefix and leaves the rest of the verb as it was.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.reveals: The question "Kanusha: Wewe unasoma." with "Wewe husoma." among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.help: Show the pair with the end of the verb circled: anasoma - hasomi.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.feedback: Katika ukanushaji wa wakati uliopo, -a inakuwa -i: hasomi. (Wewe husomi.)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.error: Keeps the tense marker -na- in the negative (hanasomi for hasomi).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.cause: The child negates by adding ha- to the whole positive verb.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.reveals: The question "Kanusha: Wewe unapika." with "Wewe hunapiki." among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.help: Cross out na in the positive form and change the end.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.feedback: Hasomi: hakuna -na- katika ukanushaji huu. (Wewe hupiki.)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.error: Negates by putting si before the positive verb (Yeye si anasoma).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.cause: Si is the negative the child knows (si mimi), so he puts it in front of any sentence.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.reveals: The question "Kanusha: Nyinyi mnasoma." with "Nyinyi si mnasoma." among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.help: Show si as the negative of ni (Yeye si mwalimu) and ha- as the negative of a verb.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.feedback: Kitendo hukanushwa kwa ha-: Yeye hasomi. (Nyinyi hamsomi.)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.error: Uses the negative prefix of another person (Wao hasomi for hawasomi; Mimi hasomi for sisomi).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.cause: The child learnt one negative form (ha-) and uses it for all persons.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.reveals: The question "Kanusha: Nyinyi mnacheza." with "Nyinyi hawachezi." among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.help: Table of persons: si-, hu-, ha-, hatu-, ham-, hawa-; the child points before writing.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T7_UKANUSHO_WA_NAFSI_YA.U.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "ghafla". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /gh/, or do not separate it from /g/; the child puts in the home sound.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "ghafla". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "gafla" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: /ng'/ and /ng/ are close; a first language with only one of them puts that one in both places.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "ngombe" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Contrast the two with a mirror and a hand before the mouth; the child says which he hears.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Splits "ghafla" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Neno "ghafla" lina silabi zipi?" with "g-h-a-f-l-a" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: gha-fla.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /gh/, /ng'/?" with "taa" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T8_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSHI.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "ng'ambo" as "ngambo".
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Neno "ng'ambo" linasomwa vipi?" with "ngambo" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Tunavuka barabara kwa uangalifu."?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Tunavuka barabara kwa uangalifu."?" with "Tunavuka ... barabara ... kwa ... uangalifu." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 42 kwa dakika

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umeangalia kulia na kushoto?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umeangalia kulia na kushoto?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T8_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KUS.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.error: Spells the word with the sound of his first language: "barabara" written "balabala".
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.cause: The child writes as he says the word; if his first language merges the two sounds, the letter is a guess.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "balabala" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.help: Keep a list of the class's hard pairs (l/r, s/sh, z/dh, s/th); say each word slowly before writing.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.feedback: Andika "barabara" kama linavyotamkwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.cause: The n or m before a consonant is soft and quick; the child does not hear it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "bele" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.help: Hum the nasal before the word (mmm-bwa, nnn-dege).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.error: Writes a long vowel short, so the word changes: "taa" written "ta".

example.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "kifaa cha kutoa mwanga".

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.cause: The child hears the length but does not know it is shown by two letters.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.reveals: The question "Andika neno lenye maana ya "kifaa cha kutoa mwanga"." with "ta" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.help: Clap the two vowels as two beats; compare a word with one and two vowels.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.error: Writes ng' without the apostrophe (ngombe for ng'ombe), or puts it where it does not belong (ng'oma for ngoma).

example.question: Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.cause: Ng' and ng are two sounds; the apostrophe looks like dirt on the page to the child.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?" with "ngombe" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.help: Say ng'ombe and ngoma: the first has no g sound; mark it with the apostrophe.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.error: Joins two words into one, or splits one word into two (kwasababu; mwana funzi).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.cause: In speech the words run together; the child has not seen each written apart.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Nilichelewa kwasababu ya mvua." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.help: Count the words aloud with a finger for each before writing.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T8_TAHAJIA.TAHAJIA.M2_TAH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.error: Uses the people word (huyu, yule) for a thing (kiti huyu).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.cause: Huyu was the first pointing word learnt; the child uses it for anything.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Mlango ___ ni mpana." with "huyu" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.help: Point at a child (huyu) and at a chair (hiki); then sort pictures by the pointing word they take.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.feedback: Kitu cha ngeli ya ki-vi huonyeshwa kwa hiki; mtu huonyeshwa kwa huyu. (huu)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.error: Uses the one-thing pointing word with a plural noun (watoto huyu).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.cause: The child changes the noun but not the pointing word.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Milango ___ imefungwa." with "huu" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.help: Pair the forms on cards: huyu-hawa, yule-wale, hiki-hivi, hili-haya.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.error: Uses hii for every noun (kitabu hii, mtoto hii), as in town Kiswahili.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.cause: Hii is the pointing word heard most in town speech, where the noun class is dropped.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Mkono ___ umeumia." with "hii" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.help: Read pairs aloud: kitabu hiki, mtoto huyu, nyumba hii; the child hears the match.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.feedback: Kitabu hiki; mtoto huyu; nyumba hii. (huu)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.error: Mixes near and far pointing words (huyu for someone far away; yule for someone close).

example.question: Mti uko mbali kule. Unasema: Mti ___ ni mrefu.

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.cause: The child has not linked the forms to distance from the speaker.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.reveals: The question "Mti uko mbali kule. Unasema: Mti ___ ni mrefu." with "huu" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.help: Stand near one child and far from another; point and say huyu and yule; then swap places.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.feedback: Huyu ni karibu nami; yule ni mbali. (ule)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T8_MATUMIZI_YA_HUU_NA_H.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.error: Says something that has nothing to do with the topic.

example.question: Mnazungumza kuhusu kumtembelea daktari. Ni sentensi ipi inafaa?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.cause: The child says what is on his mind; he has not learnt that a conversation has a topic everyone keeps to.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.reveals: The question "Mnazungumza kuhusu kumtembelea daktari. Ni sentensi ipi inafaa?" with "Jana nilitazama katuni nzuri." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.help: Put the topic picture in the middle; before speaking the child points to it.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.feedback: Tunazungumza kuhusu kumtembelea daktari; sema jambo kuhusu hilo.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.error: Talks over others and does not wait for his turn.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.cause: Eagerness: the child fears he will forget his idea.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.reveals: The question "Mwenzako anazungumza. Unafanya nini?" with "ninaanza kuzungumza pia" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.help: Pass a talking object (a ball): only the one holding it speaks.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.feedback: Subiri zamu yako; msikilize mwenzako kwanza.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.error: Mixes English or Sheng words into the Kiswahili sentence.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.cause: At home and in town the child hears mixed speech and does not know the Kiswahili word.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.reveals: The question "Sema kwa Kiswahili sanifu:" with "Daktari alinipa injection." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.help: Keep a word wall: the English or Sheng word, and its Kiswahili word next to it.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.feedback: Kwa Kiswahili tunasema: Daktari alinidunga sindano.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.error: Uses a gesture or face that does not match the words (smiling while giving sad news).

example.question: Unasema "Rafiki yangu ni mgonjwa." Uso wako unaonyesha nini?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.cause: The child smiles from shyness or does not link the face to the message.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.reveals: The question "Unasema "Rafiki yangu ni mgonjwa." Uso wako unaonyesha nini?" with "tabasamu kubwa" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.help: Say one sentence with three faces; the class picks the face that fits.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.error: Says /l/ for /r/ (or /r/ for /l/) while speaking: "rafiki" becomes "lafiki".
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.cause: Several Kenyan first languages do not separate /l/ and /r/; the home sound carries into Kiswahili.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.reveals: The question "Tamka vizuri: rafiki" with "lafiki" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.help: Practise the pairs with a mirror: the tongue taps for r, it rests for l.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.feedback: Tamka "rafiki" kwa /r/: ulimi unagonga mara moja.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T9_MAZUNGUMZO_YA_PAPO_K.M.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives "homa" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Amina alikuwa na homa. Mama alimpeleka hospitalini. Daktari alimpima na kumpa dawa. Baada ya siku tatu, Amina alipona." Neno "homa" lina maana gani?
example.correct_answer: ugonjwa wa mwili kuwa na joto jingi

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Soma: "Amina alikuwa na homa. Mama alimpeleka hospitalini. Daktari alimpima na kumpa dawa. Baada ya siku tatu, Amina alipona." Neno "homa" lina maana gani?" with "hema" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Katika kifungu, "homa" ni ugonjwa wa mwili kuwa na joto jingi.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukiugua twende hospitalini mapema tupate matibabu.

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Amina alienda hospitalini." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tukiugua twende hospitalini mapema tupate matibabu.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for, without looking at the picture.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha Amina akibeba begi la shule asubuhi. Atafanya nini?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha Amina akibeba begi la shule asubuhi. Atafanya nini?" with "Atarudi hospitalini." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Underline the clue words and point at the picture; the guess must fit them.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za picha na za kifungu: Atarudi shuleni.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kumeza dawa kama daktari anavyoagiza.

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Daktari alimpima Amina." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kumeza dawa kama daktari anavyoagiza.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.

example.question: Amina alipona baada ya siku ngapi?
example.wrong_answer: Mimi nilipona baada ya wiki moja.

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.reveals: The question "Amina alipona baada ya siku ngapi?" with "Mimi nilipona baada ya wiki moja." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.feedback: Jibu liko kwenye kifungu: siku tatu
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T9_KUSOMA_KWA_UFAHAMU.UFA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.error: Lists the things in the picture (mti, mtoto, mbwa) instead of writing sentences about what is happening.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kifungu kuhusu picha?
example.correct_answer: Mtoto anacheza na mbwa chini ya mti.

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.cause: Naming pictures was the earlier task; the child has not moved to sentences.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kifungu kuhusu picha?" with "mti. mtoto. mbwa." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.help: Ask "Nani? Anafanya nini? Wapi?" for each part of the picture.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.error: Writes no title, or a title that does not fit the writing.

example.question: Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu hospitalini?

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.cause: The child thinks the word "insha" or the date is the title.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.reveals: The question "Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu hospitalini?" with "Insha" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.help: Read the finished writing and ask: what is it about in three words?
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.feedback: Kichwa kinasema insha inahusu nini: Hospitali Yetu.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.error: Joins every sentence with "na halafu", so the writing is one long sentence.

example.question: Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?
example.wrong_answer: Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni.
example.correct_answer: Tuliamka asubuhi. Tulioga, kisha tukaenda sokoni.

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.cause: Spoken retelling joins events with na halafu; the child writes as he talks.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.help: Give a word bank: kwanza, kisha, baadaye, mwishowe; one per sentence.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.feedback: Tumia kikomo na maneno kama kisha, baadaye.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.error: Slips from one tense to another in the middle of the writing (past -li- to present -na-, or habitual hu- to past).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.cause: The child thinks of the events as he writes and the tense of the moment comes in.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Jana nilienda hospitalini. Daktari ananipima." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.help: Underline every verb; all the tense markers should match.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.feedback: Tumia wakati mmoja katika insha nzima.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.error: Puts English or Sheng words into the Kiswahili writing.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.cause: The child does not know the Kiswahili word and fills the gap with the one he knows.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.reveals: The question "Sahihisha:" with "Daktari alinipa tablets." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.help: Keep a word bank of theme words on the board before writing.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T9_KUANDIKA_KIFUNGU.KIFUN.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.error: Uses the adjective form for how something is done (anaimba mzuri for anaimba vizuri).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.cause: Mzuri is the form the child knows best and he uses it for actions too.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Muuguzi anaimba ___ (-zuri)." with "mzuri" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.help: Ask "Anaimbaje?" (how) and "Ni mtoto wa namna gani?" (what kind); the first takes vizuri, the second mzuri.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.error: Picks the opposite word of the pair (polepole for haraka, vizuri for vibaya).

example.question: Mgonjwa ana maumivu, anatembea taratibu. Anatembea ___.

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.cause: The pairs are learnt together and swapped.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.reveals: The question "Mgonjwa ana maumivu, anatembea taratibu. Anatembea ___." with "haraka" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.help: Act the pairs: walk polepole, then haraka; the child names each.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.feedback: Angalia kitendo tena na uchague neno linalofaa. (polepole)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.error: Writes the manner word with ki- (kizuri) instead of vi- (vizuri).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.cause: Ki-/vi- are heard as one family and the child picks the wrong member.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.reveals: The question "Jaza: Daktari alimtibu ___ (-zuri)." with "kizuri" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.help: Show that vizuri and vibaya always start with vi- when they tell how something is done.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.error: Uses the manner word for a quality of a thing (Chakula ni vizuri for Chakula ni kizuri).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.cause: Vizuri is heard everywhere ("ni vizuri") and the child uses it for things too.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Dawa hii ni vizuri." among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.help: Sort sentences: how something is done (vizuri) and what a thing is like (kizuri, mzuri, nzuri).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.feedback: Kitu kizuri: chakula ni kizuri; kitendo kizuri: anapika vizuri. (Dawa hii ni nzuri.)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T9_MATUMIZI_YA_VIZURI_N.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "radi". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /r/, or do not separate it from /l/; the child puts in the home sound.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "radi". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "ladi" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: /l/ and /r/ are close; a first language with only one of them puts that one in both places.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "reo" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Contrast the two with a mirror and a hand before the mouth; the child says which he hears.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.error: Splits "radi" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Neno "radi" lina silabi zipi?" with "r-a-d-i" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: ra-di.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /r/, /l/?" with "jua" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
KISW.G2.KUSIKI.T10_MATAMSHI_BORA.MATAMSH.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "radi" as "ladi".
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Neno "radi" linasomwa vipi?" with "ladi" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Mvua kubwa ilinyesha jana usiku."?

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Mvua kubwa ilinyesha jana usiku."?" with "Mvua ... kubwa ... ilinyesha ... jana ... usiku." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 45 kwa dakika

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, leo kuna jua?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, leo kuna jua?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
KISW.G2.KUSOMA.T10_KUSOMA_KWA_UFASAHA.KU.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.error: Spells the word with the sound of his first language: "radi" written "ladi".
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.cause: The child writes as he says the word; if his first language merges the two sounds, the letter is a guess.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "ladi" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.help: Keep a list of the class's hard pairs (l/r, s/sh, z/dh, s/th); say each word slowly before writing.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.feedback: Andika "radi" kama linavyotamkwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.cause: The n or m before a consonant is soft and quick; the child does not hear it.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "vua" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.help: Hum the nasal before the word (mmm-bwa, nnn-dege).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.error: Writes a long vowel short, so the word changes: "saa" written "sa".

example.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "kifaa cha kuonyesha wakati".

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.cause: The child hears the length but does not know it is shown by two letters.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.reveals: The question "Andika neno lenye maana ya "kifaa cha kuonyesha wakati"." with "sa" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.help: Clap the two vowels as two beats; compare a word with one and two vowels.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.error: Writes ng' without the apostrophe (ngombe for ng'ombe), or puts it where it does not belong (ng'oma for ngoma).

example.question: Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.cause: Ng' and ng are two sounds; the apostrophe looks like dirt on the page to the child.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?" with "ngombe" among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.help: Say ng'ombe and ngoma: the first has no g sound; mark it with the apostrophe.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.error: Joins two words into one, or splits one word into two (kwasababu; mwana funzi).
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.cause: In speech the words run together; the child has not seen each written apart.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Nilichelewa kwasababu ya mvua." among the options.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.help: Count the words aloud with a finger for each before writing.
KISW.G2.KUANDI.T10_MANENO_NA_SENTENSI.TA.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Gives the negative of the verb (hafungui) instead of its opposite action (funga).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: The child thinks "opposite" means "not doing it".
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "fungua" (dirisha) ni?" with "usifungue" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Act it: fungua the door, then funga it; not doing anything is not the opposite.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.feedback: Kinyume cha kitendo ni kitendo kingine: fungua - funga. (funga)
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Makes an opposite by adding -ua to any verb (keti -> ketua).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: Fungua/funga and vaa/vua show a pattern, and the child uses it everywhere.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "simama" ni?" with "simamua" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Sort pairs into two piles: made with -ua (funga-fungua) and different words (keti-simama).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Gives a word of the same meaning as the opposite (simama - inuka).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: The child knows the words go together but not that they mean the same.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "anza" ni?" with "zindua" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Act both words: if the action is the same, it is not the opposite.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.error: Gives a place or thing word as the opposite of an action (ingia - nje).
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.cause: Ingia and nje are heard together in "ingia ndani, toka nje".
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "panda" (mlima) ni?" with "chini" among the options.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.help: Ask "Ni kitendo?" before accepting: the opposite of an action is an action.
KISW.G2.SARUFI.T10_VINYUME_VYA_VITENDO.V.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
